name: Prismatic Majordomus
tagline: A lightweight supervisory control layer for AI-assisted work.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: set up .majordomus/ in this repository (refuses to overwrite)

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: is Majordomus itself healthy and actually wired here?

commands.name: start
commands.summary: begin a scoped task under a profile

commands.name: check
commands.summary: is the current task consistent with policy, scope, state?

commands.name: watch
commands.summary: what has drifted: state, policy, projections, retention

commands.name: handover
commands.summary: write an append-only continuation record (body on stdin)

commands.name: finish
commands.summary: evaluate the finish contract; refuse if unmet

commands.name: doctrine
commands.summary: what rules are enforced, by what, and whether they are wired
